authorized_by: user 2026-10-08: 'continue intelligently engineering until project henri has an attributable veto and ingress' + 'The 11,340 labeled-rejection pairs exist as the label source for that step.'
objective: Build an ATTRIBUTABLE veto over executor-labeled rejections. Attribute = every decision cites the feature that drove it.

hard_constraints_from_prior_measured_fai.H1_no_information_identity: The feature set must NOT contain, nor be a monotone function of, the ranker's own statistic C[q,j] = sum_m s_q[m, t_j[m]]. The old verifier used the plain inner product and scored 0.0402 vs top1 0.0401 vs shuffled 0.0401 (F3, information identity, not capacity).
hard_constraints_from_prior_measured_fai.H2_read_pre_mixing: Every statistic is read from the pre-mixing wave / pre-mixing ridge output. No operator may mix the candidate with the bank before the read (the CCCP and psi_conv defects both produced gates that could not fail).
hard_constraints_from_prior_measured_fai.H3_must_beat_random: Random pick among the top-5 previously scored 0.0579 and BEAT the trained verifier (0.0402). A real verifier must beat both random and its shuffled-label control.
hard_constraints_from_prior_measured_fai.H4_non_vacuous: The veto must reject a non-trivial, non-total fraction. Rejection rate must land in (0.02, 0.98). A gate that cannot fail will pass.
hard_constraints_from_prior_measured_fai.H5_content_only: No slot features. Candidate position within the set is randomised at train time and unusable at test time (prior self-caught defect).
hard_constraints_from_prior_measured_fai.H6_pre_registered_bar: The E1 / selection bars are frozen here, before the run.

A_position_resolved_bottleneck.motivation: C[q,j] is a SUM over positions. A sum hides a single catastrophic position. These are not monotone in the sum.

B_candidate_set_contrast.motivation: The ranker scores each candidate INDEPENDENTLY against the query. Set-relative structure is unavailable to it.

C_leave_one_out_wave_influence.motivation: Non-monotone in any single candidate score: how much the SET centroid's match to the query changes when this candidate is removed. Pre-mixing read.

controls.oracle_rerank_top5: attainable-in-principle ceiling = coverage@5; NOT an attainable system
controls.old_defect_verifier: the plain-inner-product verifier, reproduced as a documented baseline

reading_rule_FROZEN.V_C: standalone AUC of the fitted score on the pair-labeled reject task > 0.55
reading_rule_FROZEN.V_D: rejection rate at the train-selected operating point in (0.02, 0.98)
reading_rule_FROZEN.V_E: no single feature has |Pearson r| > 0.995 with C[:, j] within the candidate sets (identity check)
reading_rule_FROZEN.explicit_falsifier: If the real verifier lands within 0.005 of its shuffled control, selection is not learnable on this task and the headroom is ORACLE_ONLY. That closes the selection route.

attribution_requirement.per_decision: record the top-contributing feature for every held-out rejection
attribution_requirement.per_feature: standardized standalone AUC, fitted weight, and leave-one-feature-out delta in rerank accuracy

SAGNAC_BOUNDARY: This experiment does NOT wire the veto into the Sagnac destructive port. Blueprint Directive 3 remains BLOCKED: the ingress does not beat legacy and the veto has no measured attribution yet. This work is the ATTRIBUTABLE half only.
diagnostic_scope: CPU, D=4096, small config, single pin. No model-performance claim. Reuses the committed executor split constants (MAX_LEN 4, N_INPUTS 28, ROWS 1500, K 5, LAM 1e-3) BY IMPORT so no duplication drift is possible.
